subject: Security exhibit: sampling windows, ephemeral access, and MSA redline plan
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@luminahealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: security@luminahealth.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — security exhibit details

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the call this morning. A few asks from our security team so we can keep the renewal process moving:

1) Audit scope — Lumina needs clarity on whether the security exhibit covers Dedicated vs Private deployments separately. For SOC 2 evidence, we need confirmation of which environment(s) are in-scope and whether sampling will be tenant-limited.

2) Pen test access — we need approximate windows (2-week notice) and the expected support contact during the test. Also need the standard isolation/ephemeral access approach documented so our infra team can prepare.

3) Evidence cadence — SOC 2 artifacts and weekly snapshot exports; can you provide a proposed cadence (weekly, monthly) and retention? Our compliance team prefers weekly exports for the first 90 days post-onboarding and monthly thereafter.

4) Redlines — our legal team will send a few narrow redlines to the MSA and the security exhibit (mainly around inspection scope and data retention). Can you confirm the right contact to accept redlines (legal@redwood.com?) and the expected turnaround time?

Appreciate any detail you can share. If it's easier, we can schedule a 30-min sync with your security and legal folks.

Best,
Emily Park
Head of InfoSec Programs
Lumina Health

[Attachment: lumina-evidence-reqs.pdf (pdf)]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lumina asks — need redline/ops plan

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Lumina's note. Quick summary and proposed internal plan below.

Summary of asks from Lumina: clarify in-scope environments, pen test window details + ephemeral access play, and an evidence cadence (they prefer weekly snapshots for first 90 days). They also said legal will push narrow redlines.

Proposed internal split of work:
- Marissa: lead the evidence cadence proposal (what we can export weekly vs monthly; retention), attach sample export names and a drive link.
- Karthik: review and propose redline language for the MSA exhibit re: "inspection sampling" and "ephemeral access" that preserves our right to timebox inspections and require reasonable notice.
- I'll coordinate with infra for pen-test runbooks and list a primary on-call for the test window.

Specific asks for legal redline:
- Replace broad "all records" phrasing with scoped sampling bands (e.g., SOC2 scoped system components + tenant-limited logs).
- Add a clause for ephemeral test credentials (one-time tokens valid <=48 hours) and a technical contact for revocation.
- Maintain our evidence retention baseline of 90 days with longer-term aggregates available on request (we can offer 12 month aggregated metrics but not full raw logs by default).

Karthik — can you draft 2-3 alternative redline bullets that are narrow and negotiable? Marissa — can you assemble a short spreadsheet listing the exports we can deliver weekly (auth logs, deployment manifest, config hash list, weekly KV cache snapshot, and generated SOC2 assertion pack)?

I think a 30-min joint call with Lumina + our legal/security is warranted — propose Monday 15 March 10:00 PT. I'll hold a provisional slot.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference

[Forwarded attachment: lumina-evidence-reqs.pdf (pdf)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Lumina asks — need redline/ops plan

Stephanie / Marissa,

Draft redline language below (short bullets we can push to Lumina legal). I kept the changes focused and defensible. Happy to tighten if legal wants more formality.

1) Inspection scope / sampling: Replace any language referencing "all systems and records" with: "Customer may request inspection of system components and records reasonably scoped to the services provisioned to Customer. Redwood will provide sampled artifacts limited to tenant-specific telemetry, configuration manifests, and SOC 2 assertion output for the applicable environment. Sampling cadence and size will be set forth in the Security Exhibit and may be adjusted by mutual written agreement."

2) Ephemeral access and pen test window: Add: "Penetration tests require a documented test plan and a minimum of 14 calendar days' notice. Redwood will issue ephemeral credentials for test activities; such credentials are timeboxed (maximum 48 hours) and may be revoked immediately upon detection of anomalous activity. Redwood retains the right to require specific testing windows to avoid host maintenance or platform rollouts."

3) Evidence retention and export cadence: Add: "Redwood will make available weekly artifact exports for the first 90 days following onboarding; thereafter exports will be produced monthly unless otherwise agreed. Redwood retains raw logs for 90 days and aggregated metrics for 12 months. Additional retention or raw-log exports are available via paid support add-on."

4) Non-disclosure of other tenants: Add: "Redwood will not disclose or otherwise provide customer-specific data that contains information about other tenants. Any artifacts will be redacted or sampled to exclude cross-tenant identifiers."

Notes: these keep the spirit of Lumina's asks while protecting operational constraints. I recommend we push these as tracked changes in the MSA exhibit and attach the evidence cadence spreadsheet for transparency.

Marissa — once you post the spreadsheet I'll stitch the Exhibit section and we can send to Lumina legal ahead of the Monday call.

Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redline_bullets_plaintext.txt (txt)]

Emily — thanks for the clear asks and for being flexible on the scope call. Quick update and proposed next steps: 

1) Attached is a concise evidence-cadence spreadsheet that lists the artifacts we can provide weekly during the first 90 days and monthly thereafter (attached: evidence-cadence-proposal.xlsx).

2) Karthik drafted narrow redline bullets that we will insert into the Security Exhibit as tracked changes (attachment: Redwood_MSA_redline_v3.docx). The changes are focused on sampling, ephemeral credentials, and retention limits.

3) Pen test runbook — infra will produce a short runbook that lists the support contact and expected escalation path; we intend to share that before the call.

4) Proposed next step: 30-min joint call to walk the redlines and cadence. Proposed time: Tuesday 16 Mar 10:00 PT or Wednesday 17 Mar 09:00 PT. Please confirm which works for your team.

If Lumina legal wants to propose alternate wording, we're happy to take a narrow pass. Our aim is to keep inspections effective for your audit needs while preserving operational safety and tenant separation.

Cheers,
